field.p: Your premium. Annual. Hospital cover is shared by the family: each adult pays their age's rate, the first child the child rate, other children a lower rate. Outpatient per person or shared; maternity per family.

Co-payments. KES 1,000 per outpatient visit at Aga Khan (Nairobi, Kisumu, Mombasa), Nairobi Hospital, Gertrude's, MP Shah, Mater and Karen, all branches; KES 500 elsewhere.
Before treatment. Use the HeriAfya panel; cash paid is refunded up to 80%. Report admissions at once, emergencies within 48 hours. Cover: Kenya, East Africa, referral to India.

Not covered. Cosmetic surgery, alternative medicine, long-term care, infertility, self-injury, alcohol and drugs, experimental treatment, pandemics, dentures and implants, laser eye treatment, hearing aids, dangerous sports, and Heritage's other exclusions.
How to pay. Pay Heritage only: Stanbic Bank (Chiromo) account 0100012567965, or M-Pesa Paybill 8779000, account: policy number or name.

Please note. This is a quotation, not cover: cover starts when Heritage accepts the application and receives the full premium.
